channel.title: AI Brain — Updates, Architecture & Milestones
channel.description: Official engineering milestones, developer API previews, and company announcements from AI BRAIN STARTUPS (UDYAM-RJ-05-0067280).

item.title: Engineering Research Cluster: Multi-Hop Reasoning, Token Math & India DPDP Memory
item.description: Published three foundational architecture notes (/research): Why Cosine Similarity Fails Multi-Hop Agent Reasoning, Hypergraph vs Vector RAG Token Cost Math, and Building DPDP-Compliant Agent Memory in India.

item.title: Memory Architecture Comparison & Transparent Benchmark Protocol (/compare & /benchmarks)
item.description: Launched an objective engineering matrix comparing Flat Vector DBs, Mem0, Zep/Graphiti, Letta, and Cognee against AI Brain's planned associative hypergraph alongside our downloadable /benchmarks.json evaluation protocol.

item.title: OpenAPI 3.1 Preview Specification & Zero-JS Crawler Support
item.description: Published the machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 specification (/openapi.json) for AI Brain's pre-release Hypergraph Memory and Swarm Consensus REST endpoints (/v1/memory/remember, /v1/memory/recall, /v1/swarm/sync), alongside full SSR HTML extraction for AI search crawlers.

item.title: Founder Executive Dossier Published (/resume)
item.description: Released the verified executive technical dossier for Founder & Chief Architect Bhoja Ram Choudhary detailing MSME entity governance and system design milestones for AI BRAIN STARTUPS.

item.title: Cloud-Native Associative Hypergraph Architecture Blueprint
item.description: Documented AI Brain's hybrid memory architecture pairing compiled C++20/systems traversal kernels with planned Google Cloud Run, Vertex AI, TPU v5e, GKE, and Cloud Storage layers targeting sub-15ms p99 recall.

item.title: Pre-Seed Strategic Allocation Round ($700K Target / $4.0M Valuation Cap)
item.description: Opened AI Brain's $700,000 USD Pre-Seed Strategic Round (22 slots from $15K to $100K) structured via India iSAFE agreements with contractual 3.0x-3.5x gross revenue share and RBI FEMA P0802 compliant SBI SWIFT settlement.

item.title: AI BRAIN STARTUPS Registered Under Govt. of India MoMSME (UDYAM-RJ-05-0067280)
item.description: AI BRAIN STARTUPS officially registered as a Government of India Ministry of MSME micro enterprise (NIC Code 62099 — IT, software and computer services) in Rajasthan, India.
